chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch. 596: Li Huowang’s Quiet Hell in a Psychiatric Ward
chapter_meta_description: In the quiet of a new hospital, Li Huowang tries to find peace. But a fellow patient's chilling recognition shatters the illusion, reminding him that terror follows him, even to this mundane hell.
og_title: The Scariest Thing in a Psych Ward is Recognition
og_description: Li Huowang tries to blend in, but a fellow patient’s terrified gaze reminds him who he truly is.
twitter_title: Can’t Escape a Legend, Even in a Psych Ward
twitter_description: Li Huowang checks into a private hospital for peace, but a single, terrified scream proves his past is a monster he can’t leave behind.

lore_anchors.definition: A psychiatrist at Kangning Hospital and a junior of Yi Donglai; he is responsible for Li Huowang’s intake and care.
Li Huowang’s fiercely protective mother, who struggles to leave him alone in the hospital.
Li Huowang’s father; Li Huowang calls him to convince Sun Xiaoqin to leave the hospital.
